Ariane 5はWebb宇宙望遠鏡を打ち上げた。: Ariane 5 launched the Webb Space Telescope.
Webbの遮熱膜の展開工程は12月28日に始まり、1月4日に完了した。: Deployment of Webb’s sunshield began on December 28 and was completed on January 4.
遮熱膜を左右に広げる二つのミッドブームが伸び、所定の位置に固定された。: The two mid-booms that spread the sunshield sideways extended and were secured in position.
遮熱膜の最初の三層の張力調整が完了した。: Tensioning of the first three sunshield layers was completed.
Webbの副鏡支持構造が展開され、固定と工程の完了が確認された。: Webb’s secondary mirror support structure was deployed, and its securement and completion were confirmed.
Webbの主鏡の最後の翼が展開・固定され、主要構造の展開が完了した。: The last wing of Webb’s primary mirror was deployed and secured, completing the major structural deployments.
Webbは最後の軌道修正噴射によって太陽・地球系L2周辺の軌道へ入った。: Webb’s final course-correction burn placed it in orbit around Sun–Earth L2.
副鏡支持構造の展開工程を開始した。: Deployment of the secondary mirror support structure began.
副鏡が展開位置まで移動した。: The secondary mirror moved into its deployed position.
副鏡支持構造がラッチで固定された。: The secondary mirror support structure was latched in place.
技術者が副鏡支持構造の固定と展開完了を確認した。: Engineers confirmed that the secondary mirror support structure was secured and deployment was complete.
Webbの後部モメンタムフラップは、保持装置を解放した後、ばねの力で最終位置へ展: Webb’s aft momentum flap deployed to its final position by spring force after its hold-down devices were released.
Webbの伸展タワーは、望遠鏡と観測装置を遮熱膜および宇宙機本体から離し、遮熱膜: Webb’s deployable tower separated the telescope and instruments from the sunshield and spacecraft bus, making room for full sunshield deployment.
工程の開始から完了まで。電力系統とモーターの最適化のための停止日を含み、連続稼働: From the start to the completion of the deployment process, including pauses for power-system and motor optimization. This does not imply continuous operation.
遮熱膜の幅方向への展開。五層の張力調整はこの後の工程。: Sideways deployment of the sunshield. Tensioning all five layers was a later step.
太陽に近い側の三層。五層すべての完了とは区別する。: The three layers closest to the Sun; distinct from completing all five layers.
2022年1月5日の工程。この日の内訳はESTで報告された概数時刻。: The January 5, 2022 process. The detailed times for that day were reported as approximate EST times.
構造の展開完了。光学調整や科学観測の準備完了を意味しない。: Completion of structural deployment, not completion of optical alignment or readiness for science observations.
L2点の周辺を巡るハロー軌道。地球周回軌道やL2点での静止とは区別する。: A halo orbit around L2, distinct from orbiting Earth or remaining stationary at L2.
位置への到達。ラッチによる固定や完了確認とは区別する。: Arrival at the deployed position, distinct from latching or confirmation of completion.
機構による固定。地上側の完了確認とは区別する。: Mechanical securement, distinct from ground confirmation of completion.
工程の完了確認。記事公開時刻ではない。: Confirmation of process completion, not the publication time of the article.
2022-01-05 EST の概数時刻。資料の時刻表記を順序として保持し、UT: Approximate EST times on January 5, 2022. The reported order and times are retained without converting to UTC or inventing second-level precision.
